name: Compartmentalization
description: The adversary is applying compartmentaliztion to reduce the risk of exposure of his activities. Compartmentalization prevents cross-contamination.

subtechniques.name: Maintained normalcy cover profile
subtechniques.description: The adversary deliberately maintains a visible, mundane public digital presence to prevent absence of digital footprint from being anomalous to surveillance systems. The public profile provides plausible cover and can be automated. A public-use phone is actively used for non-sensitive activity and taken across border controls. Private operational activity uses entirely separate infrastructure.
